name: spinner
description: Shows that something is loading when you can't say how far along it is: a panel, a list or a page section waiting for data. Screen readers hear a busy progress bar named by its label, so give it one that says what is loading. Draws in the text color around it. The three looks mean the same thing: pick one for the whole product and keep it. When the shape of the coming content is known, a skeleton shows it better; inside a button, use the button's isPending instead.

props.name: variant
props.description: The look: a ring with a running arc, three rising dots, or eight bars fading round (iOS-like). Use the same one everywhere in a product.

props.name: size
props.description: sm sits next to a line of text, md fills a card or panel, lg a whole page section.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What screen readers hear; say what is loading, such as "Loading invoices".
